categories.serpDescription: Connect providers that run Google rank checks in Rank Tracker.
categories.analyticsDescription: Connect owned-data sources such as Google Search Console or Google Analytics 4 to add traffic and query performance context. Analytics sources are not used to determine rank positions.

drawer.oauthTitleCloud: Sign in with Google, read-only. Tokens are stored encrypted in your workspace.
drawer.oauthTitleSelfHost: Sign in with Google, read-only. Tokens are stored encrypted in your instance.
drawer.keyTitle: Use your own provider account. Credentials are stored encrypted in your instance.
drawer.credentialApiPasswordHelp: Use your API password, not your account password.
drawer.credentialApiTokenPlaceholder: Stats API token from your Plausible account
drawer.credentialApiBaseUrlHelp: Leave blank for Plausible Cloud. Set this only for a self-hosted instance.
drawer.credentialSavedSecret: Saved and encrypted. Leave blank to keep the current value, or enter a new one to replace it.
drawer.costHelp: Optional USD cost of one rank check at your configured depth - for DataForSEO Live, Top 10 is about 0.002 and Top 100 is about 0.0155.

oauth.oauthHelp: Google OAuth handles access for this connection. No API key is required.
oauth.scopeSearchConsoleReadonly: webmasters.readonly (property list + search analytics + sitemap status)
oauth.ga4PropertyHelp: In Google Analytics 4, open Admin (gear, bottom-left) → Property settings → Property details and copy the digits-only Property ID. You can also search for “Property ID” in Analytics. Do not paste a G- Measurement ID or UA- tracking ID. See Google's <propertyGuide>Property ID guide</propertyGuide> and <measurementGuide>Measurement ID guide</measurementGuide>.
oauth.unavailable: Not available to this Google account
oauth.selectGa4Help: Choose a property returned by Google Analytics, or enter its numeric ID manually.
oauth.selectGscHelp: Domain properties cover all subdomains; URL prefixes cover one path.
oauth.loadGa4Error: Could not load your GA4 properties.
oauth.ga4FailureAuth: This Google account may not have Analytics access, or Google rejected the request.
oauth.ga4FailureConfig: The Google Analytics API configuration is invalid. Check the API setup and try again.
oauth.ga4FailureRateLimit: Google's request limit was reached. Try again shortly.
oauth.ga4FailureUnknown: This Google account may not have Analytics access, or the Analytics API rejected the request.
oauth.emptyGa4: This Google account returned no Google Analytics 4 properties. Enter the numeric Property ID manually or use a different account.
oauth.emptyGsc: This Google account has no verified Search Console properties. Verify a property or connect a different account.

byo.title: Bring your own providers.
byo.detail: In self-hosted bisibility you connect your own accounts. Credentials stay in your instance and provider usage is billed directly between you and each provider.
